q_A: SELECT vote_id , phone_number , state FROM votes
gold_q_B: SELECT "votes"."vote_id" AS "vote_id", "votes"."call_up" AS "phone_number", "votes"."state" AS "state" FROM "VOTES" AS "votes"

q_A: SELECT max(created) FROM votes WHERE state = 'CA'
gold_q_B: SELECT MAX("votes"."made") AS "_col_0" FROM "VOTES" AS "votes" WHERE "votes"."state" = 'CA'

q_A: SELECT DISTINCT state , created FROM votes
gold_q_B: SELECT DISTINCT "votes"."state" AS "state", "votes"."made" AS "created" FROM "VOTES" AS "votes"

q_A: SELECT T2.created , T2.state , T2.phone_number FROM contestants AS T1 JOIN votes AS T2 ON T1.contestant_number = T2.contestant_number WHERE T1.contestant_name = 'Tabatha Gehling'
gold_q_B: SELECT "t2"."made" AS "created", "t2"."state" AS "state", "t2"."call_up" AS "phone_number" FROM "CONTESTANTS" AS "t1" JOIN "VOTES" AS "t2" ON "t1"."contestant_number" = "t2"."contestant_number" WHERE "t1"."contestant_name" = 'Tabatha Gehling'
